props.content_text: The ROUTER-100 is a high-performance enterprise network router designed for mission-critical applications requiring maximum throughput, reliability, and security. This next-generation routing platform supports advanced features including dynamic routing protocols, traffic engineering, and comprehensive security policies. The system is built on a modular architecture that provides exceptional scalability and field-upgradability.

props.figure_caption: Figure 1: ROUTER-100 System Architecture showing main processing unit, interface modules, and management subsystem

props.content_text: The ROUTER-100 delivers industry-leading performance with forwarding rates up to 100 Gbps and support for up to 2 million routing table entries. The system features redundant power supplies, hot-swappable interface modules, and comprehensive fault tolerance mechanisms to ensure maximum network uptime.
